name: minimal file fills every default
service defaults to host root and keeps index metadata
index.purpose defaults to empty string when given
toml:
[project]
name = "acme"
domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "docker/compose.yaml"

[service.api]
[service.api.index]
label = "API"
purpose = "the API"

name: two services share a host when their paths differ
duplicate host root claim
want:
test.toml is not a valid treerig.toml:
  service.web.subdomain: the host root is already claimed by service "api"

name: duplicate path claim on the host root
want:
test.toml is not a valid treerig.toml:
  service.api2.path: the host root at path "/api" is already claimed by service "api"

name: duplicate claim on a named subdomain
want:
test.toml is not a valid treerig.toml:
  service.b.subdomain: subdomain "app" is already claimed by service "a"

name: a service table defined twice is a TOML error
want: test.toml is not valid TOML: toml: line 10 (last key "service"): Key 'service.api' has already been defined.

name: [[service]] rejected, saying services are tables keyed by name
want:
test.toml is not a valid treerig.toml:
  service: Invalid input: expected object, received array (services are tables keyed by name: write [service.<name>], not [[service]])

name: name inside a service table rejected, with a hint at the key
want:
test.toml is not a valid treerig.toml:
  service.api: Unrecognized key: "name" (the table's key is the service name: [service.api])

name: service name that is not a slug rejected at its key
want:
test.toml is not a valid treerig.toml:
  service.Api: must be lower-case letters, digits, and hyphens

name: a second service on the host root is a route collision
want:
test.toml is not a valid treerig.toml:
  service.web.subdomain: the host root is already claimed by service "api"

name: path with backtick and Host() injection rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid treerig.toml:
  service.s.path: must be a URL path starting with /, without spaces, quotes, backticks, $, ? or #; % must be followed by two hex digits

name: path with bad percent-escape rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid treerig.toml:
  service.s.path: must be a URL path starting with /, without spaces, quotes, backticks, $, ? or #; % must be followed by two hex digits

name: path with query string rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid treerig.toml:
  service.s.path: must be a URL path starting with /, without spaces, quotes, backticks, $, ? or #; % must be followed by two hex digits

name: path with dollar sign rejected (Compose would interpolate it)
want:
test.toml is not a valid treerig.toml:
  service.s.path: must be a URL path starting with /, without spaces, quotes, backticks, $, ? or #; % must be followed by two hex digits

name: path with RFC 3986 punctuation and percent-escapes accepted
path of just the root slash accepted
subdomain starting with a hyphen rejected

name: subdomain ending with a hyphen rejected

hooks with an empty string value rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid treerig.toml:
  hooks.prepare: Too small: expected string to have >=1 characters

name: all five hook stages configured
toml:
[project]
name = "acme"
domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "docker/compose.yaml"

[hooks]
prepare = "./prepare.sh"
seed = "./seed.sh"
verify = "./verify.sh"
backup = "./backup.sh"
restore = "./restore.sh"

name: output key order follows the schema, not the file
service field order in output follows the schema, not the file
a table between two [[service]] blocks leaves both services whole
an index table after an interleaved table belongs to the service above it
unknown keys in an interleaved second service are reported in file order
toml:
[project]
name = "acme"
domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "docker/compose.yaml"

[service.api]
[hooks]
seed = "./seed.sh"
[service.mail]
zeta = 1
alpha = 2
want:
test.toml is not a valid treerig.toml:
  service.mail: Unrecognized keys: "zeta", "alpha"

name: an inline array of service tables
toml:
[project]
name = "acme"
domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "docker/compose.yaml"

service = [{ name = "api" }, { name = "mail", subdomain = "mail" }]
want:
test.toml is not a valid treerig.toml:
  compose: Unrecognized key: "service"

name: invalid TOML reported distinctly from invalid configuration

     ^
